# Space for R code 

Use the space below to answer the questions that don't rely on raw data

```{r}
pnorm(5, mean = 3, sd = 4, lower.tail = F)
qnorm((1+0.88)/2)
qnorm((1+0.90)/2)

#Q4
z <- (0.75 - 0.70) / 0.05
z

#Q5
t <- ((112 - 120) / (sqrt(12^2/60 + 14^2/100)))
t

#Q6
p1 <- 140/200
p2 <- 150/250
se <- sqrt((p1 * (1-p1)/200) + (p2 * (1-p2)/250))
t_ci <- (p1-p2) - qnorm((1+0.90)/2) * se
t_ci
```

# PA Seniors

Use the space below to work with the dataset 'PASeniors' from the Lock5Data package.

```{r}
#load the dataset into your workspace
data(PASeniors)
prop.test(~Vegetarian, p = 0.10, alternative = "less", data = PASeniors, success = "Yes")
t.test(~Height, alternative = "two.sided", data = PASeniors, conf.level = 0.90)
t.test(HWHours~Allergies, alternative = "two.sided", data = PASeniors, conf.level = 0.98, success="Yes")


```
